flag_warnings.max_model_len=180000: Chain governance mandates 180000; experiments validated KV-pool fit (221616 tokens, 1.23× concurrency at 180000) on B300, but generation quality at full 180k context not specifically swept. Set high enough that cross-node PoC validation matches; lower would diverge on long-context prompts.
flag_warnings.max_num_seqs=128 (batch_size=64 hard cei: Phase 3 sweep on B300 confirms batch_size=64 hangs the PoC engine (OOM-stuck, not crash — engine never recovers). Same failure mode as B200/H200/H100/A100 MiniMax profiles. max_num_seqs=128 from MINIMAX_M2_7 base is safe because vLLM runtime caps actual batch by KV cache; the hazard is operator-supplied PoC batch override.

flag_descriptions.validation-report: Hardware validation — 1×B300 SXM6 (bare server, 275 GiB HBM, 2026-05-23). PoC throughput 1792 nonces/min @ batch=32 — highest per-GPU of any hardware. Inference TTFT 1.28 s (fastest), 746 output tok/s. Nonces cross-validate with 2×B200 baseline: mean L2 0.266, PASS under MiniMax chain gate (0.75/0.10). Image starts out-of-the-box (no env override needed — unlike A100; Blackwell auto-selects FLASHINFER_TRTLLM correctly).
flag_descriptions.max_model_len=180000: Chain governance mandates 180000; experiments validated KV-pool fit (221616 tokens, 1.23× concurrency at 180000) on B300, but generation quality at full 180k context not specifically swept. Set high enough that cross-node PoC validation matches; lower would diverge on long-context prompts.
flag_descriptions.tensor_parallel_size=1: Validated single-B300 (275 GiB HBM) configuration — MiniMax-M2.7 FP8 (230 GB) fits with 1.23× concurrency at max_model_len=180000. Phase 3 batch sweep on B300: 8→1392, 16→1728, 32→1792 (best), 64→hang. The chain VRam=320 GB nominal requirement is conservative; 1×B300 (275 GB) cross-validates with the B200 fleet under the MiniMax chain gate.
flag_descriptions.attention_backend=FLASHINFER: vLLM auto-selector picks FLASHINFER on Blackwell; B300 image starts out-of-the-box with no env override. Pinning explicitly so the auto-selector heuristic doesn't silently regress this profile across vLLM versions.
